arrive.title: SHIMMER
arrive.sub: every level is a star to place

map.title: STAR MAP
map.full: Every star in it is placed
map.north: The North Star lights when all six are full

perks.name: Bigger can
perks.line: One more pour every time you fill the can.

perks.name: Morning dew
perks.line: Your first watering of the day starts a spell of double garden XP.

perks.name: Lucky seed
perks.line: A harvest sometimes gives a seed back.

perks.name: Tidy plots
perks.line: Weeds come back slower on your plots.

perks.name: Green streak
perks.line: Water five plots in a row for a short spell of half again garden XP.

perks.name: Rich compost
perks.line: Compost works twice as fast.

perks.name: Golden crop
perks.line: Now and then a plant ripens golden and counts as a rarer crop.

perks.name: Good neighbour
perks.line: Watering someone else’s plot gives it an extra day of growth.

perks.name: Rain catcher
perks.line: Rain counts double on your plots.

perks.name: Bloom trail
perks.line: Flowers spring up where you walk in the park.

perks.name: The Watering Can
perks.line: Your plots shimmer for everyone who walks past, a rare seed lands in your bag each week, and the Watering Can lights the town’s night sky.

perks.name: Full trough
perks.line: The trough lasts two days.

perks.name: Morning round
perks.line: Each animal’s first hug of the day gives double hearts.

perks.name: Double yolk
perks.line: Eggs sometimes come in twos.

perks.name: Slow fade
perks.line: Hearts fade slower.

perks.name: Happy herd
perks.line: Hug every animal in a row for a spell of half again farm XP.

perks.name: Rich milk
perks.line: Milk sometimes makes two cheeses.

perks.name: Tidy yard
perks.line: While you are away, the grass takes twice as long to grow long.

perks.name: Helping hand
perks.line: Your hugs and feeds in other yards count double for them.

perks.name: Cat’s treasure
perks.line: Your cat brings rarer gifts to the door.

perks.name: Barn lights
perks.line: Warm lanterns light your yard for visitors.

perks.name: The Barn
perks.line: A golden weathervane on your roof, one more animal, and the Barn lights the town’s night sky.

perks.name: Quick fix
perks.line: Putting a problem right takes half the time.

perks.name: First fix
perks.line: Your first fix each day pays triple XP.

perks.name: Ghost luck
perks.line: A ghost sometimes counts twice.

perks.name: Tally’s note
perks.line: Tally shows you tomorrow’s order today.

perks.name: On a roll
perks.line: Three quick fixes in a row start a short spell of half again town XP.

perks.name: Arcade regular
perks.line: Six more arcade runs a day pay XP.

perks.name: Lamplighter
perks.line: Lamps glow brighter as you pass.

perks.name: Good citizen
perks.line: When you fix a problem, everyone on the square gets a little XP.

perks.name: Night owl
perks.line: Your first ghost each day pays triple.

perks.name: The bell
perks.line: The clock chimes when you arrive in town.

perks.name: The Clock Tower
perks.line: Your name on a plaque by the fountain, and the Clock Tower lights the town’s night sky.

perks.name: Steady hands
perks.line: A wider window to land a catch.

perks.name: Catch of the day
perks.line: Your first fish each day is uncommon or better.

perks.name: Lucky line
perks.line: Rare fish bite more often.

perks.name: Beachcomber
perks.line: More shells wash up for you.

perks.name: Hot streak
perks.line: Three catches in a row bring a short spell of better luck.

perks.name: Treasure nose
perks.line: A second treasure dig each day.

perks.name: Storm chaser
perks.line: A quarter more bay XP in rain and storms.

perks.name: Shared catch
perks.line: A rare catch gives everyone on the beach a little XP.

perks.name: Legend’s ripple
perks.line: The legendary fish shows a ripple when it is near.

perks.name: Star bobber
perks.line: Your bobber leaves a trail of light.

perks.name: The Fish
perks.line: A captain’s hat, your rare catches told to the whole bay, and the Fish lights the town’s night sky.

perks.name: Light feet
perks.line: An extra dance move.

perks.name: Doors open
perks.line: Your first stretch on the floor each day pays half again.

perks.name: Spotlight love
perks.line: The spotlight finds you more often.

perks.name: Jelly keeper
perks.line: Jelly drains slower.

perks.name: Floor filler
perks.line: Dance without stopping for a while and a peak starts at half again.

perks.name: Long peak
perks.line: A jelly peak sometimes lasts twice as long.

perks.name: Party starter
perks.line: Everyone on the floor gets a little more XP while you dance.

perks.name: Glowstick rain
perks.line: Now and then a free glowstick falls your way.

perks.name: Peak hour
perks.line: The night’s busiest hour pays a quarter more.

perks.name: Disco shadow
perks.line: Sparkles on the floor around you.

perks.name: The Disco Ball
perks.line: Your name lights the club sign while you dance, a disco-ball hat, and the Disco Ball lights the town’s night sky.

perks.name: More colours
perks.line: More colours in the palette.

perks.name: Daily spark
perks.line: A theme each day, and making one pays XP.

perks.name: Bigger canvas
perks.line: More pixels to draw on.

perks.name: Draft drawer
perks.line: Keep five more drafts.

perks.name: Mirror tools
perks.line: Flip and rotate what you draw.

perks.name: Star frame
perks.line: Your catalog pieces get a star frame.

perks.name: Makers’ praise
perks.line: When someone wears your piece in a room, you both get XP.

perks.name: Second layer
perks.line: Draw on two layers.

perks.name: Signed
perks.line: Your pieces carry a small star signature.

perks.name: Approved bonus
perks.line: Approved pieces pay half again in XP.

perks.name: The Hammer
perks.line: A Master Maker mark on your catalog pieces, an anvil for your homestead, and the Hammer lights the town’s night sky.

perks.name: The North Star
perks.line: A star named after you in the town’s night sky, for good, and soft starlight follows your banana.
